edges: The Pentamerone is structured around the story of Zoza, a cursed princess.
The old woman cursed Zoza to marry only the prince of Round-Field.
Zoza seeks to wake the prince.
The husband hires ten female storytellers, including Zoza.
The Moorish woman's treachery is revealed in the final story told by Zoza.
Zoza and the Prince live happily ever after.
